_comment: Frozen version-axis contract as of the release BEFORE station-intent reconciliation (issue #106). tests/release_contract.rs compares the current constants against this file, so an axis that must not move is asserted against a recorded previous value rather than against a second copy of the current constant (which would assert nothing).

notes.station_intent_schema_version: Did not exist before this release; introduced at 1.
notes.protocol_minor: Bumped 4 -> 5 by ReconcileIntents plus the intent status projection.
notes.min_compatible_plugin_version: Asserted UNCHANGED. The plugin hook surface (copilot/plugin/hooks.json, copilot/plugin/plugin.json) is untouched by this work; the new probe verb is a bridge-extension change gated by copilot_bridge_protocol. A future change to the plugin/bridge contract must revisit this axis explicitly.
